instruction.text: Samantha is thinking of a number. 50% of Samantha’s number is 16. Work out the number Samantha is thinking of.

atoms.a: What percentage of Samantha’s number do you need to work out?
What is <mat>16/32</mat> in its simplest form?

instruction.text: Jerry has a jar of 200 jelly beans. He wants to give 25% to his friend. Work out how many jelly beans his friend gets.

atoms.a: What division can the fraction be written as?
How many jelly beans does his friend get?

instruction.text: Niamh is making an apple crumble. She peels an apple and cuts it into even slices. One slice is 10% of the whole apple. Work out how many slices she cuts.

atoms.a: What percentage represents the whole apple?
Write 10% as a fraction in its simplest form.

instruction.text: The price of a t-shirt is reduced by 25% from £40. Work out the new price.
instruction.sound: The price of a tshirt is reduced by 25% from £40. Work out the new price.

atoms.a: Next, subtract your answer from the original price.

instruction.text: Bill and Cece have run 50% of their 24-kilometre run. Work out how far they have run so far.
Adebola got 10% of the 30 words on her spelling test wrong. Work out how many words she got right.
50 children were asked what their favourite pet is. 16 chose dogs, 9 chose cats, 8 chose hamsters, 14 chose birds and 3 chose fish. Work out the percentages for each pet.

atoms.a: Convert the percentage of children who chose dogs into a fraction.
Convert the percentage of children who chose birds into a decimal.
